about: pop'n music 9 (Konami Python 1, C00:J:A:A) e-AMUSE3 calls, decrypted. captured: sent by the game in HIRAKU (2026-10-13); otherwise built from the game's own request format strings (not seen yet; encryption guessed from the module's other calls). See docs/EAMUSE3.md. In the captured userid.adduser and addcard, the card numbers are replaced by test numbers (20030199999999xx), so replaying the corpus doesn't give KONAMI IDs to numbers a server hands out.
